headline: Sempra (SRE) Stock Trades At A Premium Near Fair Value
summary: Sempra stock has delivered a 56.5% total return over the past 5 years, yet its current checks suggest the shares are not an obvious bargain at today’s price. After that run, investors are weighing steady utility cash flows and growth projects against a lower value score and mixed recent sentiment.
